# CLI reference

FunScript 0.2.3. This page is generated from [the CLI command catalogue](../../src/cli/commands.ts).

## Commands

### `funscript build`

```text
funscript build <file.fun|file.funx...> [--target bun] [--out <file>] [--outDir <dir>] [--sourcemap] [--no-check] [--no-ts] [--no-global-this] [--no-optional] [--bare-pipelines] [--bin] [--watch]
```

Build FunScript files to TypeScript or TSX, or bundle one entry and its local modules as a Bun executable.

```sh
funscript build src/Button.funx --sourcemap
```

```sh
funscript build src/cli/bin.fun --target bun --out dist/cli/bin.js
```

### `funscript emit`

```text
funscript emit <file.fun|file.funx> [--out <file.ts|file.tsx>] [--sourcemap] [--no-ts] [--no-global-this] [--no-optional] [--bare-pipelines] [--bin]
```

Compile one FunScript file to TypeScript or TSX.

```sh
funscript emit src/main.fun --out src/main.ts --sourcemap
```

### `funscript check`

```text
funscript check [file.fun|file.funx...] [--idiomatic] [--json] [--warnings-as-errors] [--no-ts] [--no-global-this] [--no-optional] [--bare-pipelines]
```

Statically type-check files with the TypeScript API and optionally emit machine-readable diagnostics.

```sh
funscript check examples/shapes.fun
```

```sh
funscript check src --json --warnings-as-errors
```

### `funscript tsc`

```text
funscript tsc [TypeScript options]
```

Run the project's TypeScript compiler and map type-view diagnostics to FunScript sources.

```sh
funscript tsc --noEmit
```

### `funscript run`

```text
funscript run <file.fun|file.funx> [--no-check] [--no-ts] [--no-global-this] [--no-optional] [--bare-pipelines] [-- arg... ]
```

Bundle and run a FunScript program and its local imports with Node.js.

```sh
funscript run examples/hello.fun
```

```sh
funscript run src/main.fun -- --verbose
```

### `funscript repl`

```text
funscript repl
```

Start the interactive REPL.

```sh
funscript repl
```

### `funscript lsp`

```text
funscript lsp [--stdio]
```

Start the Language Server Protocol server.

```sh
funscript lsp --stdio
```

### `funscript fmt`

```text
funscript fmt <file.fun|directory...> [--check] | fmt --stdin [--stdin-filepath <path>]
```

Format FunScript source files or directories, check formatting, or format source read from standard input.

```sh
funscript fmt src --check
```

```sh
funscript fmt --stdin --stdin-filepath src/main.fun
```

### `funscript pipeline-style`

```text
funscript pipeline-style <bare|qualified> <file or directory...>
```

Convert pipeline stages while preserving compiler output.

```sh
funscript pipeline-style bare src/
```

### `funscript version`

```text
funscript version
```

Display the FunScript version.

Aliases: `-v`, `--version`.

```sh
funscript version
```
